title: Fix Codex subscription gameplay diagnostics and MCP approvals
description: Codex-sub gameplay can fail because obsolete RMCP config remains, MCP tools are not pre-approved under approvalPolicy=never, stale build artifacts can carry obsolete model defaults, and Codex SDK subprocess failures discard useful stdout JSONL errors. Implement all four fixes with regression coverage and release/build safeguards.
acceptance_criteria: Remove experimental_use_rmcp_client; configure required/pre-approved Eshyra MCP tools; prevent stale dist from entering release artifacts; preserve useful Codex stdout errors on nonzero subprocess exit; all relevant tests and verify:worktree pass.
close_reason: Implemented all four Codex-sub fixes with unit, full-suite, and live SDK/MCP validation.
